svg.text: as a story years
before they meet it
as a bill
one quarterly
ritual, not one
more screen

text.tspan: turns one money idea into one story
draws it, then folds it into paper
checks the lesson is true before it prints
last read, then it goes to press
commissions the volume, holds the date
makes a pop-up a six-year-old can't break
one copy is opened by hand before the run
moves the quarter's run in one wave
lands before the school term does
rebuilds the spreads as things to replay
what the child has played, book to book
what to say at the kitchen table

svg.text: A box on the mat is
the service buys.
Twenty minutes where
the lesson is
alone, and
Billy and Buddy argue about it, so nobody has to lecture
One idea a volume — sixteen ideas, not one lecture
Pulling a tab is a decision made with their hands
Every mechanism survives a hundred openings
Mini games repeat the lesson with no adult in the room
Progress the child can see stacking up between books
Which spreads get replayed, and which get skipped
Library and school demand sizes the next print run
Parents' notes become the next author brief
$100 a year, or $10 a month
One payment covers all sixteen volumes
Curated, drawn, fact-checked, edited
Four people, one idea, one quarter
Pop-up mechanics cut, folded, glued
A proof copy is opened before the run
Libraries and educational institutions
And a box on the mat at home
Read it, pull it, argue with it
Then play the lesson back online
AND THEN IT COMES ROUND AGAIN
